'''Navi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who represented [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]] and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Sephi1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Navi being scolded by his uncle]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> as corruption in the Galactic Senate went along, Navi's uncle, [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]] noticed that his nephew had become narrow-minded and ignorant as a result of the corruption touching Navi's soul and heart. Alaric elected to work against the Republic's corruption and made a decision to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems under the rule of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="JediYoda" />

After Thustra declared its intent to separate from the Republic, Alaric recalled his nephew from Coruscant to return home to Thustra. Navi deeply resented this decision in no small part due to being forced to give up the prestigious and luxurious lifestyle that he enjoyed as a senator. During negotiations between his uncle and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], Navi burst into the king's throne room with his aide [[Moje]] and criticized his uncle for the monarch's recent decisions. The king in turn quickly rebuked Navi, saying that the former knew about the latter's corrupt practices as a senator and failure to properly represent Thustra.

After Master Yoda and Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Cal (Jedi)|Cal]] were placed under house arrest by Alaric's orders, Navi and Moje joined the Jedi in their quarters where Navi used his political skills and rhetoric to influence the Jedi against Alaric. Navi tried to manipulate them into believing that King Alaric had become mentally unwell and that his decisions were not based on logic and reason. Instead, Master Yoda saw through the deception and revealed Navi's motives as self-serving. Seeing that his words had no effect on Yoda, Navi left Yoda and Cal, but not before accusing them of serving their own interests and refused to claim responsibility if anything bad were to happen to the Jedi.

In an attempt to keep Thustra in the Republic, Navi and Moje began manipulating events to their advantage. First, Moje went to Cal and deceived him into believing that the Jedi could take a waiting shuttle back to the Republic's forces. When Cal rushed off to find the shuttle, Moje tricked the palace guards into believing that the Jedi intended to assassinate King Alaric. Meanwhile, Navi traveled to [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Clutch/Legends|Clutch]] and Jedi Commander [[Pix (Jedi)|Pix]] with false news that the king had executed both Yoda and Cal before providing the most recent movements of Sephi's forces and detailed information about the palace. This deception convinced Pix and Clutch to lead their forces in an all-out assault on the Sephi, while Navi left Thustra and returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to rally support for his people.

While the Republic launched its [[Battle of Thustra|assault]] on the Sephi and incurred many casualties among them, Yoda and Cal were forced into a fight with the palace guards and led to Cal's death. Yoda confronted Alaric once more and failed to persuade the king to stand down. Alaric, realizing that his own nephew had brought about so much death and destruction on his world, instead chose to die a martyr's death by forcing Yoda to kill him. Navi's machinations led the Sephi and the neighboring star systems to rally around the king's death and secede from the Republic.

After the battle on Thustra ended, Navi returned to Coruscant and appeared in the Galactic Senate hoping to gather support for his world. While attempting to declare to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] that Yoda was killed during the Battle of Thustra, he was interrupted by Yoda himself. As a result, [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] ordered he be arrested for crimes against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and conspiracy to commit murder. As Navi was being led away by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], he screamed out that he was only serving the best interests of his people.<ref name="JediYoda" />

== Personality and traits ==
{{Quote|If I thought you were helping matters in the Senate--instead of trying to profit from them--I wouldn't have called you back, Navi.|Alaric|<ref name="JediYoda" />}}
As a senator, Navi was obligated to represent and serve the interests of the Sephi in the Galactic Senate. Unfortunately, the corruption that had grown rampant in the Republic tainted him so much that he became like the majority of his fellow senators: greedy, self-serving, and more concerned with prestige and luxury than the needs of his people. This was seen most clearly with two of his aides in his senatorial pod being young women chosen for their looks. 

According to his uncle, Alaric, Navi had spent too much time away from Thustra that his nephew had lost touch with his roots on his home planet. Navi's time in the Senate had gifted him with talents of persuasion and rhetoric that he unfortunately used for his own personal gain, such as when he tried to convince Yoda and Cal that Alaric had lost his mind only to fail. Further, he had used those same talents to successfully deceive the Jedi and Republic forces into attacking the Sephi forces and his uncle's palace.

Navi could also be considered hypocritical in that he was clearly trying to further his own interests while accusing the Jedi of the exact same thing. Another instance of this happened when, during his in the Senate for his crimes against the Republic, he claimed to be acting in the best interests of his people. Thus, it could be argued that Navi's only real motive was to continue to enjoy the prestige and perks of being a senator for himself and that his machinations were intended to ensure that.
